newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish fighter plane ditches over Britain.
newsitem.headline: Danish fighter plane ditches over Britain.

text.p: A Royal Danish Air Force F-16 fighter crashed into the sea off the east coast of Britain on Wednesday but its two-man crew ejected safely, an air force statement said.
The statement said that the aircraft, on an exercise over Britain, crashed shortly after taking off from Marham air force base, northeast of London.
The reason for the incident was not yet known, the statement said. It added that the pilots were unharmed but were being kept under routine observation in a British hospital.
